title: Bounded Closure
$comment: The first-class object of DESIGN-compile-before-query §3: a complete, goal-free account of everything reachable within a declared horizon of one registered world. For every state below the horizon, `outgoing` contains EVERY syntactically possible action from the registered action schema, each recorded as either the native verifier's refusal or the exact successor. The object is generated, never hand-edited; it contains no desired endpoint, success predicate, reward, query text, or model score. It is untrusted by construction — the generic checker (scripts/closure_check.py) rebuilds the reachable graph independently from the frozen sources and requires exact bidirectional equality. Canonical form: states sorted by state_digest, outgoing rows sorted by canonical_action bytes, convergence cells sorted by end_state_digest, JSON serialized with sorted keys — so a semantics-preserving reorder (corruption class 12) normalizes to identical bytes and closure digest.

source_manifest.$comment: Canonical-LF SHA-256 of every frozen source file this closure was built from. The checker reloads and digest-checks each one before trusting anything else in this object (design §5 step 1).

action_schema_digest.$comment: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the registration's action_schema. The checker recomputes it from the registration file, so a closure cannot claim to have enumerated a different product than the one registered.

convergence_cells.$comment: At most one cell per noninitial end state, derived — not chosen — by the checker's canonical rule (design §6): the primary route follows lexicographically-first minimum-depth predecessors; the alternate is the first other accepted incoming edge whose reconstructed route differs. The builder cannot omit, inject, or cherry-pick cells; the checker recomputes the exact set.

closure_digest.$comment: SHA-256 over the canonical serialization of this object with this field removed. Recomputed by the checker; never trusted from the file.

canonical_state.$comment: The exact canonical bytes of the state as UTF-8 text (the adapter's canonicalize output). A digest match with unequal canonical bytes is refused as corruption, so both travel together.

outgoing.$comment: Empty exactly when minimum_depth equals the horizon (a boundary state, which claims nothing about the next step). For every interior state this array carries one row per enumerated schema action — no more, no fewer.

canonical_action.$comment: Canonical JSON of {name, params} with sorted keys — the enumerated schema action, not the adapter's native action.

refusal_code.$comment: The world's own deterministic refusal, recorded verbatim (verdict and reason, or failed check names). Present exactly when disposition is 'illegal'; successor_digest exactly when 'successor'. JSON Schema cannot express that exclusivity without allOf gymnastics; the checker enforces it structurally.

actionRoute.$comment: An ordered list of canonical_action strings. Semantically ordered: corruption class 12 (meaning-preserving reorder) must never touch a route.
